exploration.bamboo_pass.start.text: Morning mist hangs over Bamboo Pass. The path splits three ways: an old road, a stream, and a ridge trail.
exploration.bamboo_pass.old_road.text: Deep wheel ruts mark the old road. A traveling courier rests by the roadside, sizing you up. Farther on, muddy footprints crisscross the path.
You read the prints: armed men, heading for a camp.
The prints tangle and you circle back, tired.
exploration.bamboo_pass.courier.text: The courier introduces himself as Lu Chenzhou. He thinks you walk too slowly, but he is willing to talk.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.text: The stream runs clear. Something glints between the stones.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.su: Between the stones: half a water-stained letter and some herbs.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.fa: You slip into the stream and lose some strength.
exploration.bamboo_pass.ridge.text: The ridge is steep and windy. You haul yourself up and the valley opens below.
exploration.bamboo_pass.lookout.text: A camp hides in the valley below. A scholar-like young man copies notes at the cliff edge: Bai Yan.
exploration.bamboo_pass.camp_edge.text: You creep to the camp's edge. A few guards lounge against the stakes; supplies are stacked inside.
You find a supply ledger and pocket some loose silver.
The guards spot you and you flee. (The skirmish arrives in a later milestone.)
exploration.bamboo_pass.gate.text: At the pass's end stands an old gate, its lintel carved with faded marks.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_plain.text: You pass the gate safely and the trek ends. Something in these hills is not finished yet.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_wise.text: You read the marks: they point to someone behind the camp. You leave the pass carrying that secret.
exploration.bamboo_pass.desc: Mist-bound Bamboo Pass: three paths, each with its own encounters and clues.

story.day1_intro.n1: Welcome to Jade Valley, young one. Bandits have their eyes on the pass, and we must get ready this month.
story.day1_intro.n2: Each week has two slots. Pick an activity; it costs stamina, and when you run low, rest.
story.day1_intro.n3: Choose your path of cultivation first. Every bit of training makes you stronger and changes how others see you.
story.day2_path.choose: A few days have passed. Time to choose your path.
story.day2_path.choose.fist: Follow The Way of the Mystic Fist
story.day2_path.choose.sword: Follow The Way of the Green Blade
story.day2_path.choose.rain: Follow The Way of Listening Rain
story.day2_path.choose.later: Let me think a little longer
story.day2_path.chosen: Your path is set. Each practice takes it deeper.
story.day2_path.done: You have already chosen your path. Good. Keep sharpening it.
story.day4_battle.n1: At dawn a villager stumbles into the valley: bandit scouts are raiding the foot of the mountain!
story.day4_battle.n2: Please, they are taking the whole village's food!
story.day4_battle.n2.together: Ask your companion to come along
story.day4_win.n1: Thank you! Without you the whole village would be lost.
story.day4_win.n2: The bandits will soon learn someone defends the valley. Use the next two weeks well.
story.day4_lose.n1: You were forced to retreat. The villagers are shaken and some are hurt.
story.day4_lose.n2: Do not lose heart. Defeat teaches too, but time is short.
story.day5_faction.n1: Three parties visit within the same week, each hoping you will stand with them.
story.day5_faction.n2: Your choice gives the valley something to lean on. Choose carefully.
story.day5_faction.n2.pavilion: Stand with the Herb Pavilion (Shen Qinghe)
story.day5_faction.n2.couriers: Stand with the Courier Road (Lu Chenzhou)
story.day5_faction.n2.scribes: Stand with the Scribes' Study (Bai Yan)
story.day6_prepare.n1: The bandit chief arrives soon. Prepare this week, or scout Bamboo Pass if you like. Exploring is optional.
story.day7_crisis.n1: The month is nearly over. The bandit chief's band has gathered at the pass, torches strung in a line.
story.day7_crisis.n2: Two slots remain this week. Use them well; once it ends comes the decisive fight.
story.crisis_final.n1: People of Jade Valley, hand over what you hide and I will spare you!
story.crisis_final.n1_saved: The villagers you saved stand behind you with torches. No one steps back.
story.crisis_final.n2: Night falls, and the decisive fight begins.

world.area.valley_village.name: Jade Valley Village
world.area.valley_village.desc: Chimney smoke, flagstones and neighbours: where every road begins.
world.area.valley_village.w1: You spend half an hour at the village gate listening to an old man's tales.
world.area.valley_village.w2: Children crowd round for a story at the market; a few coins find your hand.
world.area.valley_village.w3: A cup of hot tea at the stall lets you breathe.
world.area.river_bend.name: Dragon-Return Bend
world.area.river_bend.desc: The stream turns here, and the fish gather.
world.area.river_bend.w1: You gather a few fish stranded in the shallows.
world.area.river_bend.w2: The sound of water settles your mind.
world.area.herb_terraces.name: Herb Terraces
world.area.herb_terraces.desc: Terraced herb beds climb the slope, lushest in spring and summer.
world.area.herb_terraces.w1: You pick a handful of common herbs.
world.area.herb_terraces.w2: The steep path leaves your legs lighter.
world.area.old_shrine.name: Abandoned Mountain Shrine
world.area.old_shrine.desc: The incense died years ago, yet someone still comes and goes.
world.area.old_shrine.w1: The worn stele sets you thinking.
world.area.old_shrine.w2: You sit before the altar a while; your breathing evens out.
world.area.ferry_dock.name: Linjiang Ferry Dock
world.area.ferry_dock.desc: The ferry out of the valley, where news arrives faster than boats.
world.area.ferry_dock.w1: The boatman tells you a few tales of the jianghu.
world.area.ferry_dock.w2: You help carry some cargo and are paid.
event.f_aftermath.1: Two days after the raid the village gate still smells of smoke, and everyone quietly clears the wreckage.
event.f_aftermath.2: "Those were no ordinary bandits," Elder Mo says quietly. "Their blades had schooling. This is not over."
event.f_aftermath.3: I nod and keep the words close.
event.f_gossip.1: "Heard? When they pulled back they went up the rear hill. There've been lights at the shrine at night."
event.f_gossip.2: The shrine… abandoned for years. Worth a look.
event.f_shrine_first.1: Fresh footprints cross the dust before the altar, and two shady figures crouch in a corner.
event.f_shrine_first.c.sneak: Slip away and note what they say
event.f_spring_fair.1: The spring fair opens; coloured cords hang across the lane and traders have come from the next town.
event.f_spring_fair.2: "Come have a bowl of hot soup and share the cheer!"
event.f_spring_fair.3: I help set up stalls all afternoon and come away well paid.
event.f_herb_lesson.1: "Gathering herbs is not weeding," Elder Mo says, crouching. "Know the root, read the season, leave the seed. Those are the rules."
event.f_ferry_rumor.1: The old ferryman lowers his voice: "The ringleader of the shrine crowd rode my boat, headed toward Cangwu."
event.r_village_chat.1: "They say it's rough outside the valley. Take your training seriously."
event.r_village_chat.2: I smile and agree, but the words stick.
event.r_herb_find.1: A rare herb grows bright in a rock crevice.
event.r_fish_tale.1: An old fisherman hands you half a grilled fish: "Young one, the fish are strong where the water runs fast."
event.r_bandit_stray.1: "Halt! Leave your coins!" A straggling bandit leaps from the reeds.
event.r_shrine_dream.1: You doze by the broken wall and dream of an armoured swordsman drilling in the courtyard.
event.r_shrine_dream.2: I wake with my palms oddly warm.
event.r_elder_lesson.1: "Watch the feet before you strike," Elder Mo remarks in passing, and you listen closely.
event.r_winter_frost.1: Frost lies thick as snow; villagers gather round the hearth and invite you to sit.

event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.title: The Old Prescription
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.1: Shen Qinghe spreads a yellowed prescription across the basket lid, a fingertip resting beside the last herb. "My master wrote this just before falling ill."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.2: "The prescription is sound. The bowl he drank was not." She looks up. "Will you help me find out?"
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.3: I nod. "Whatever you need, just ask."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.title: The Master's Sickbed
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.1: In the hillside cottage the medicine smells bitter and thick. The old man lies still, his breathing barely stirring the blanket.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.2: "There is something in the dregs that should not be," Shen Qinghe says quietly. "A secret medicine only the Accord uses."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.3: I help her sort the dregs bit by bit until the light goes.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.title: The Accord's Secret Medicine
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.1: "I traced the secret medicine," Shen Qinghe says, twisting her sleeve. "If I expose it, the Accord will hunt me. If I stay silent, my master gets no cure."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.open: Urge her to tell the truth
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.quiet: Help her find the cure in secret
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.leave: Tell her to protect herself and let go
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.title: Moonlit Herb Beds
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.1: The herb beds are so quiet at night that dew can be heard falling. Shen Qinghe sits on the ridge, looking up at the moon.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.2: "Thank you, for all of this," she smiles. "What would you like to be to me?"
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.title: The Unsigned Letter
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.1: On the ferry steps of the Bend, Lu Chenzhou crouches over an unsigned letter, unusually serious.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.2: "I'm a courier. I never open letters," he says, turning it over. "But I know this handwriting, and the man died three years ago."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.3: I look at the letter. "Then who sent it?"
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.title: Chasing the Letter
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.1: "Someone wants this letter," Lu Chenzhou says, keeping his voice low. "My pack was searched last night, and today I was followed."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.2: "Stop! Hand over the letter!" Figures burst from the reeds.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.c.slip: Pull him round a back path
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.title: What the Letter Said
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.1: The letter is open. Inside is a ledger proving a ferry-side bigwig sold out his comrades. Lu Chenzhou stares at it, silent.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.2: "Someone offered ten times my fee for it," he says softly. "I have never seen so much money."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.deliver: Urge him to give it to someone who will see justice done
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.burn: Burn it, so both sides can step down
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.sell: Let him go; the money is real
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.title: Night Talk at the Ferry
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.1: The night ferry is empty, its lantern drawing a long streak of light on the water.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.2: "You ask what I'd like to be to you?" Lu Chenzhou scratches his head. "I've thought about all of it."
event.arc_bai_yan_1.title: Rubbings of the Broken Stele
event.arc_bai_yan_1.1: Bai Yan lays a stack of rubbings on the altar, ink drowning the smell of dust. "The stele does not hold prayers. It holds a fragment of a manual."
event.arc_bai_yan_1.2: "A manual? Who carves martial arts on a shrine stele?"
event.arc_bai_yan_1.3: "Someone who wanted it hidden." He nudges the lamp closer. "I want to finish reading it."
event.arc_bai_yan_2.title: Hidden Marks in the Rubbings
event.arc_bai_yan_2.1: "Look here," Bai Yan says, pointing between the strokes. "Another script hides in the gaps."
event.arc_bai_yan_2.2: We trace stroke by stroke beside the lamp until the oil runs dry.
event.arc_bai_yan_3.title: Knowledge and Danger
event.arc_bai_yan_3.1: The fragment is read through. It records a technique that can unhinge a mind, the very thing the Accord has long sought.
event.arc_bai_yan_3.2: "Publish it and people will bleed for it; destroy it and one possibility vanishes from the world." Bai Yan looks at you. "What do you think?"
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.share: Urge him to publish the first half so people know its harm
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.keep: Keep one copy, in his own hands
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.burn: Urge him to burn the rubbings
event.arc_bai_yan_4.title: Lamp in the Shrine
event.arc_bai_yan_4.1: The lamp burns quietly as Bai Yan sorts the last page of notes.
event.arc_bai_yan_4.2: "These days you taught me something: some things count without being understood." He looks up. "What would you be to me?"

world.area.bamboo_pass.name: Bamboo Pass
world.area.bamboo_pass.desc: The one road out of the valley, bamboo rising on both sides.
world.area.bamboo_pass.w1: Leaves whisper as you drill a few footwork patterns along the road.
world.area.bamboo_pass.w2: A bamboo cutter presses two hot flatbreads into your hands.
world.area.lj_docks.name: Linjiang Docks
world.area.lj_docks.desc: A forest of masts; chanting rises from dawn to midnight.
world.area.lj_docks.w1: You haul a few crates and the foreman tosses you a handful of coins.
world.area.lj_docks.w2: An old boatman teaches you to read ripples, and you pick up the trick.
world.area.lj_market.name: Linjiang Market
world.area.lj_market.desc: Shouts, aromas and bells packed into a single street.
world.area.lj_market.w1: A stallkeeper gives you a honey cake: "luck of the passerby."
world.area.lj_market.w2: You mind a stall for an afternoon and earn a few coppers.
world.area.lj_teahouse.name: Clear-Heart Teahouse
world.area.lj_teahouse.desc: The upstairs seats hold all sorts; one pot of tea buys a day of rumours.
world.area.lj_teahouse.w1: The storyteller at the next table reaches the good part and you lose yourself in it.
world.area.lj_teahouse.w2: The owner lets you taste a new tea.
world.area.lj_escort.name: Pingyuan Escort Bureau
world.area.lj_escort.desc: A pair of stone lions guard the gate; someone is always drilling inside.
world.area.lj_escort.w1: The escorts let you spar a few rounds.
world.area.lj_escort.w2: The bookkeeper asks you to carry a letter and tips you a few coins.
world.area.lj_pawn.name: Ten-Thousand-Treasures Pawnshop
world.area.lj_pawn.desc: The counter is taller than a man and the keeper's eye truer than his scales.
world.area.lj_pawn.w1: You find some usable ore in an old crate in a corner.
world.area.lj_pawn.w2: In idle talk the keeper mentions a few old rumours of the martial world.
world.area.lj_alleys.name: Night Alleys
world.area.lj_alleys.desc: Empty by day; lamps only after dark.
world.area.lj_alleys.w1: You watch a gambling game from the shadows and learn to read faces.
world.area.lj_alleys.w2: A stray cat leads you around a night patrol.
event.q1_tally.title: Half a Tally
event.q1_tally.1: That night Elder Mo stokes the fire and takes a half-cut jade tally from the bottom of a chest, laying it in your palm.
event.q1_tally.2: "This was wrapped in your blanket the day you were brought here. Where the other half lies I do not know. But the men who raided the valley were looking for it."
event.q1_tally.3: "Jade Valley was once the 'ninth house'. I have kept that secret for you all my life."
event.q1_tally.c.ask: Keep the tally and ask about the 'ninth house'
event.q1_tally.c.rest: Put it away; ask another day
event.q1_bamboo.title: Ambush on the Bamboo Road
event.q1_bamboo.1: At the end of the bamboo road a masked rider reins in, two guards behind him. A Barge Guild wooden token hangs at his belt.
event.q1_bamboo.2: "Valley kid, leave the half tally and we will call today a day we never met."
event.ry1_bamboo_mist.title: Morning in the Bamboo
event.ry1_bamboo_mist.1: Morning mist seals the bamboo road, so you drill a set of forms in it and come out with a damp collar.
event.ry1_bamboo_cutter.title: The Bamboo Cutter
event.ry1_bamboo_cutter.1: The bamboo cutter wipes his brow: "Plenty of strangers on the road lately. Keep your eyes open."
event.ry1_bend_heron.title: Heron in the Shallows
event.ry1_bend_heron.1: A heron stands motionless in the shallows. You watch it so long that you glimpse something of stillness.
event.q2_arrival.title: First Steps in Linjiang
event.q2_arrival.1: Linjiang's docks are ten times bigger than you imagined. You have barely stepped off the boat when a self-styled 'guide' blocks the way.
event.q2_arrival.2: "Outsider, the 'safe-passage fee' first. Three taels and nothing happens to you."
event.q2_arrival.c.wit: Argue loudly until the watch comes
event.q2_qian_man.title: Qian Man's Counter
event.q2_qian_man.1: Behind the counter Qian Man does not look up: "From Jade Valley? The one with half a jade?"
event.q2_qian_man.2: My stomach tightens. "How do you know?"
event.q2_qian_man.3: "In Linjiang there is nothing I do not know, only prices I do not care to sell at. The escort bureau is short of hands. Go there; you may hear what you want."
event.q2_su_dai.title: Pipa at the Market
event.q2_su_dai.1: A crowd circles a corner of the market. A girl with a pipa on her back plays and sings, bells chiming with the beat.
event.q2_su_dai.2: "You there, you have listened to my song. If not a tip then at least leave a name?"
event.q2_su_dai.3: I give my name, and her eyes crinkle with her smile. "I am Su Dai. Next time I will sing you a new one."
event.arc_su_dai_1.title: The Song That Hides a Map
event.arc_su_dai_1.1: "My mother left me this song," Su Dai says quietly. "But I keep feeling the words hide something else."
event.arc_su_dai_1.2: "Listen: 'Cross the bridge at the third watch, seek the star against the current.' Who sings a song that specific?"
event.arc_su_dai_1.3: I think of the tally and the Nine Stars and feel a stir. "Perhaps it is a map."
event.q2_dragon_boat.title: Dragon-Boat Day
event.q2_dragon_boat.1: The Dragon-Boat Festival has come: drums thunder over the river, the long boats line up, and both banks are packed.
event.q2_dragon_boat.2: "One paddler short! Who will join? Win the prize and we all share!"
event.q2_dragon_boat.c.watch: Watch from the bank and buy snacks
event.q2_li_shan.title: The Burned Smithy
event.q2_li_shan.1: At the end of the docks stands a blackened smithy, only half a furnace left. A huge man crouches in the ashes, searching.
event.q2_li_shan.2: "Nothing... sold here any more." He looks up, voice low. "Somebody burned the forge."
event.q2_li_shan.3: I crouch and help him dig through the rubble.
event.arc_li_shan_1.title: Lighting the Furnace Again
event.arc_li_shan_1.1: "This iron did not burn by itself," Li Shan says, pinching a pale slag. "Someone poured oil in the furnace. They wanted the ledger burned, and the ore."
event.arc_li_shan_1.2: "I want to light this furnace again. I need ore, and... someone willing to help."
event.arc_li_shan_1.c.sift: Help him sift ashes for the ledger
event.arc_li_shan_1.c.ore: Leave some ore and a promise
event.q2_escort.title: Escort North
event.q2_escort.1: The head of Pingyuan Escort Bureau claps your shoulder: "Friend, a consignment goes north along the trade road. It is not safe. Will you ride along?"
event.q2_escort.2: Halfway along the road, figures leap out of the trees.
event.q2_escort.c.detour: Take a back path and avoid the clash
event.q2_barge_guild.title: The Alley Warehouse
event.q2_barge_guild.1: Beneath the cargo crates a tiny anchor is carved: the Barge Guild's mark.
event.q2_barge_guild.2: You follow the mark into the deep alleys. Lamplight leaks from the door of an unremarkable warehouse.
event.q2_barge_guild.c.sneak: Sneak in and read the ledgers
event.q2_fragment.title: The First Star
event.q2_fragment.1: The Barge Guild master sits in a prow, slowly rubbing a dark stone shard. "I hear you are looking for this."
event.q2_fragment.2: "It is the first fragment of the Nine Stars. I can let you study it, on one condition: from now on you protect the guild's boats."
event.q2_fragment.c.refuse: Decline, and find your own way
event.ry1_dock_porter.title: Soup on the Dock
event.ry1_dock_porter.1: A porter hands you a bowl of hot soup with a grin: "New here? Rest up, Linjiang's work never ends."
event.ry1_dock_fisher.title: Fishing off the Pier
event.ry1_dock_fisher.1: An old fisherman by the pier teaches you to read the waterline and find the fish.
event.ry1_market_haggle.title: Haggling
event.ry1_market_haggle.1: You bargain on behalf of an old woman, and she shares half the savings with you.
event.ry1_market_acrobat.title: Tumblers on a Rope
event.ry1_market_acrobat.1: Street acrobats tumble on a rope; you watch, and glimpse something about balance.
event.ry1_tea_gossip.title: Teahouse Talk
event.ry1_tea_gossip.1: People at the next table chat about the sects' recent moves; you listen quietly for half an hour.
event.ry1_escort_drill.title: Escort Drill
event.ry1_escort_drill.1: The escorts are drilling the 'Three Talents' formation and pull you in to fill a corner.
event.ry1_pawn_curio.title: A Trinket on the Counter
event.ry1_pawn_curio.1: Qian Man lazily pushes over a small iron plate: "A trinket. No charge."
event.ry1_alley_cat.title: The Alley Cat
event.ry1_alley_cat.1: In the night alleys a stray cat leads you around a few drunks.
ability.soothing_tune.desc: A tune that restores an ally's resolve.
ability.bell_strike.desc: Bells that rattle the enemy and weaken them.
ability.pipa_crescendo.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): restores 8 HP and resolve to an ally within range 3.
ability.hammer_blow.desc: A heavy blow that knocks the enemy back a cell.
ability.iron_taunt.desc: Presence that weighs on the enemy and weakens them.
ability.forge_oath.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): restores 12 HP and 6 resolve to an ally within range 2.
companion.su_dai.bio: A street musician with a pipa on her back who helps through song. Loves a crowd and a good story.
companion.li_shan.bio: A quiet smith, strong as an ox, who shields his friends. The forge is his one subject.
world.lead.linjiang_token.name: The Guild Token
world.lead.linjiang_token.desc: The Barge Guild token at the rider's belt may lead you to answers in Linjiang.
world.lead.escort_job.name: The Escort Job
world.lead.escort_job.desc: Qian Man says the escort bureau needs hands. Try Pingyuan.
world.lead.barge_trail.name: The Anchor Mark
world.lead.barge_trail.desc: A Barge Guild anchor is carved under the crates.
world.lead.fragment_one.name: The Alley Warehouse
world.lead.fragment_one.desc: The guild keeps a warehouse in the alleys, perhaps hiding the first star.
world.lead.fragment_traced.name: The First Star
world.lead.fragment_traced.desc: The first fragment of the Nine Stars has been traced.
world.lead.song_map.name: Su Dai's Song
world.lead.song_map.desc: The song's verses seem to hide a route.
world.lead.burned_forge.name: The Burned Forge
world.lead.burned_forge.desc: Li Shan's smithy was burned on purpose, and it has to do with a lot of ore.
world.lead.tea_rumor.name: Teahouse Rumours
world.lead.tea_rumor.desc: The teahouse buzzes with news of the sects.
world.area.cw_gate.name: Cangwu Gate Steps
world.area.cw_gate.desc: Nine hundred stone steps climb into cloud, guarded by old pines.
world.area.cw_gate.w1: You climb the steps one by one; the legs ache but the mind settles.
world.area.cw_gate.w2: A gate disciple sees your manners and passes on a few house rules.
world.area.cw_courts.name: Training Courts
world.area.cw_courts.desc: Blue-stone courts where disciples spar from dawn.
world.area.cw_courts.w1: You watch half an hour of sparring from the edge.
world.area.cw_courts.w2: A senior brother trades a few moves and hands you a flask of water.
world.area.cw_library.name: Scripture Library
world.area.cw_library.desc: Three storeys of timber, ink and old paper mingled.
world.area.cw_library.w1: In a corner you find a damaged copy of the Pine-Wind Notes.
world.area.cw_library.w2: The old keeper asks you to air the books and tips you a few coins.
world.area.cw_cave.name: Cliff Cave
world.area.cw_cave.desc: A natural cave halfway up the cliff, once a place of seclusion.
world.area.cw_cave.w1: The cave is bitterly cold; you sit in the dark for a while.
world.area.cw_cave.w2: A few glinting ore chunks sit in the rock crevices.
world.area.cw_spring.name: Hot Spring
world.area.cw_spring.desc: A natural hot spring on the slope, steaming; disciples come here to mend.
world.area.cw_spring.w1: A soak in the spring melts the tiredness out of you.
world.area.cw_spring.w2: Voices murmur in the steam; you catch a few words and leave.
event.q3_invitation.title: The Cangwu Invitation
event.q3_invitation.1: A teahouse waiter hands you an invitation stamped with a pine crest: "Cangwu School invites young talents to its triennial tournament."
event.q3_invitation.2: At the bottom is a line in small characters: "Please bring the half tally."
event.q3_invitation.3: How do they know about the tally? I tuck the invitation away.
event.q3_gate_steps.title: The Gate Trial
event.q3_gate_steps.1: Before the gate a stern man stands with hands behind his back. "I am Gu Xingzhou. Cangwu has one rule: once you climb, learn first to wait."
event.q3_gate_steps.2: "Admission trial: nine hundred steps in one breath, no help allowed."
event.q3_gate_steps.c.steady: Steady the breath, one step at a time
event.q3_library.title: Old Scrolls in the Library
event.q3_library.1: On the library's second floor Bai Yan is bent over a copying desk, one sleeve stained with ink.
event.q3_library.2: "Ah, you came too! The collection is bigger than I imagined, and more dangerous." He lowers his voice. "Someone has tampered with the Nine-Star files."
event.q3_library.3: I help him list the suspicious files one by one.
event.q3_xie_wujiu.title: The Dark-Red Spear
event.q3_xie_wujiu.1: At the edge of the courts a young man in a faded dark-red robe leans on a long spear, watching the bouts coldly. Disciples step around him as they pass.
event.q3_xie_wujiu.2: "New? You did well on the gate trial." He raises an eyebrow. "Care to trade a few moves? I am not here to be polite."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.title: The Wrong of Three Years Ago
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.1: "I was Cangwu's youngest inner disciple," Xie Wujiu says, gazing at the distant pines. "Three years ago something vanished from the library, and everyone said I took it."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.2: "I did not. But I cannot find proof." His grip tightens on the shaft. "Whether you believe me, I do not care."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.3: I look into his eyes. "I believe you. If you want, I will help you look."
event.q3_mid_autumn.title: Mid-Autumn Night
event.q3_mid_autumn.1: On Mid-Autumn night lanterns hang in the pines by the spring, disciples and guests sitting round to watch the moon.
event.q3_mid_autumn.2: The moon climbs high, and you wonder whom to sit with.
event.q3_tournament_1.title: Tournament: First Round
event.q3_tournament_1.1: On the platform Gu Xingzhou announces: "First round, two against two. Winners advance."
event.q3_tournament_1.2: Two disciples across the ring salute, their eyes anything but soft.
event.q3_tournament_2.title: Tournament: Second Round
event.q3_tournament_2.1: "Second round. Three against three; once the drum sounds, no stopping."
event.q3_tournament_3.title: Tournament: The Final
event.q3_tournament_3.1: "The final." Gu Xingzhou gestures at the silent senior in the ring. "The strongest outer disciple in ten years. Win or lose, it is an honour."
event.q3_theft.title: The Theft
event.q3_theft.1: The tournament has barely ended when a cry rises from the library: the pine-wind score that guards the hall is gone.
event.q3_theft.2: "Who was last in the loft?" Every disciple's eyes turn to Xie Wujiu in the corner.
event.q3_theft.3: "Me again?" He sneers. "You have never once changed your line."
event.q3_theft.c.public: Stand up for him in public
event.q3_theft.c.quiet: Quietly look into it for him
event.q3_hui_mask.title: The Grey Mask
event.q3_hui_mask.1: Deep in the cliff cave a figure in a grey mask stands with his back to you before the rock wall.
event.q3_hui_mask.2: "Child of Jade Valley." He does not turn. "The less you know, the safer you are. Go back."
event.q3_hui_mask.3: I want to press him, but he dissolves into the dark like smoke.
event.ry3_gate_pines.title: Sweeping Leaves
event.ry3_gate_pines.1: Beneath an old pine a monk sweeps leaves. He smiles and hands you a bamboo broom.
event.ry3_courts_spar.title: Sparring Partner
event.ry3_courts_spar.1: A disciple invites you to spar: "Do not hold back!"
event.ry3_courts_drill.title: Thirteen Pine-Wave Forms
event.ry3_courts_drill.1: To drumbeats the disciples drill the Thirteen Pine-Wave Forms, and you follow at the tail.
event.ry3_library_read.title: A Book on Breath
event.ry3_library_read.1: You find an old book on breathing and read it through the afternoon.
event.ry3_library_keeper.title: Footsteps at Night
event.ry3_library_keeper.1: The old keeper murmurs: "Lately there are footsteps in the hall at night."
event.ry3_cave_echo.title: Echo in the Cave
event.ry3_cave_echo.1: The cave's echo runs long; you call into the dark and listen to it recede.
event.ry3_spring_soak.title: A Rest by the Spring
event.ry3_spring_soak.1: The spring is warm; you close your eyes and listen to the pines.
event.ry3_spring_gossip.title: Talk by the Spring
event.ry3_spring_gossip.1: Two senior sisters chat as they soak: "They say the master has other plans for this tournament."
combat.scenario.xie_duel.objective: Defeat the disciple Xie sets against you.
ability.spear_sweep.desc: A sweeping spear that knocks the enemy back.
ability.spear_oath.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): an extra strike within range 2.
companion.xie_wujiu.bio: A prodigy cast out of Cangwu, sharp with the spear, cold outside and warm within.
world.lead.cangwu_invite.name: The Cangwu Invitation
world.lead.cangwu_invite.desc: Cangwu School invites you to its tournament and asks for the half tally.
world.lead.library_files.name: Tampered Files
world.lead.library_files.desc: Someone has tampered with the Nine-Star files in the library.
world.lead.frame_whisper.name: Xie Wujiu's Wrong
world.lead.frame_whisper.desc: A theft three years ago was pinned on Xie Wujiu; he says he is innocent.
world.lead.theft_clue.name: The Stolen Pine Score
world.lead.theft_clue.desc: The pine-wind score is stolen again, and Xie Wujiu is the suspect once more.
world.lead.hui_mask_seen.name: The Grey Mask
world.lead.hui_mask_seen.desc: A grey-masked man in the cliff cave knows you come from Jade Valley.
world.lead.library_footsteps.name: Footsteps in the Library
world.lead.library_footsteps.desc: Footsteps sound in the library at night, perhaps connected to the theft.
world.area.ms_flats.name: Fishing Flats
world.area.ms_flats.desc: Shallows and mudflats run together; oars knock somewhere in the fog.
world.area.ms_flats.w1: You sit at the flats half a day and land a few fat fish.
world.area.ms_flats.w2: Someone's footprints cross the mud; you follow them a while.
world.area.ms_reeds.name: Reed Maze
world.area.ms_reeds.desc: Reeds taller than a man; one turn and the way back is lost.
world.area.ms_reeds.w1: You read the wind among the reeds and slowly pick a way.
world.area.ms_reeds.w2: A few ore chunks, washed out by the water, lie hidden in the reeds.
world.area.ms_temple.name: Sunken Star Temple
world.area.ms_temple.desc: A stone temple half-sunk in water, its walls carved with star charts.
world.area.ms_temple.w1: You study the star charts on the broken walls for a long time.
world.area.ms_temple.w2: The temple is eerily quiet; you use it to steady your breath.
event.q4_marsh_rumor.title: Rumors of the Marsh
event.q4_marsh_rumor.1: Boatmen at the docks mutter: "In the Sunken-Star Marsh a light climbs from the water to the sky every night."
event.q4_marsh_rumor.2: The tally warms faintly in my coat. Perhaps it is time to look.
event.q4_ferryman.title: The Old Ferryman
event.q4_ferryman.1: At the end of the flats an old man poles a small boat: "Only the stars know the way to the temple. How do you ask?"
event.q4_ferryman.2: "Do you listen to the water, or watch the sky?"
event.q4_reeds.title: The Reed Maze
event.q4_reeds.1: Fog rises among the reeds. Someone calls your name nearby, familiar but not quite right.
event.q4_reeds.2: I stop and try to place where the voice is coming from.
event.q4_reeds.c.mark: Bend reeds to mark the way
event.q4_solstice.title: Winter Solstice
event.q4_solstice.1: On Winter Solstice night every house steams dumplings and the shrine lamp is lit.
event.q4_solstice.2: Elder Mo hands you a hot bowl. "However far you go, come home for the feast."
event.q4_solstice.3: Whom do you want to share the bowl with?
event.q4_temple.title: The Sunken Temple
event.q4_temple.1: Deep in the temple a stone door is set into the wall. The tally burns warm and starlight seeps through the seam.
event.q4_temple.2: The door stays shut. But one star on the carved chart lights up.
event.q4_temple.3: The first star... so this is the Nine-Star Gate.
event.q4_ambush.title: Ambush on the Flats
event.q4_ambush.1: On the flats back, a dozen grey-clad figures rise from the reeds. Their captain sneers: "Leave the tally and you may walk."
event.q4_ambush.2: These are the Gate's probes. I clench my fists.
event.q4_elder_fork.title: Elder Mo's Fate
event.q4_elder_fork.live.1: You are back. I never let the lamp at the gate go out.
event.q4_elder_fork.live.2: The village is safe and so are you. For the first time in years I slept soundly.
event.q4_elder_fork.live.3: I will keep Jade Valley. You go and walk your road.
event.q4_elder_fork.retire.1: You won, but the village lost someone.
event.q4_elder_fork.retire.2: I cannot hold this place any more. Let me follow you; these old bones can still give counsel.
event.q4_elder_fork.fall.1: By the time you reach Jade Valley, the lamp before the shrine has gone out.
event.q4_elder_fork.fall.2: Elder Mo leans in the doorway and presses an old seal into your hand: "Do not look back. The Nine Stars are more than one gate."
event.ry4_flats_fish.title: A Quiet Cast
event.ry4_flats_fish.1: The float dips and you lift a fat fish.
event.ry4_flats_mist.title: Oars in the Mist
event.ry4_flats_mist.1: Oars sound in the mist but no boat appears.
event.ry4_reeds_birds.title: Startled Egrets
event.ry4_reeds_birds.1: Egrets burst from the reeds and you follow where they fly.
event.ry4_reeds_ore.title: Ore in the Mud
event.ry4_reeds_ore.1: Your boot strikes something hard in the mud: ore.
event.ry4_temple_chart.title: Tracing the Chart
event.ry4_temple_chart.1: You trace the chart's lines on your palm over and over.
event.ry4_temple_rest.title: A Rest in the Temple
event.ry4_temple_rest.1: The temple steps are dry; you sit and rest.
world.lead.marsh_open.name: The Sunken-Star Marsh
world.lead.marsh_open.desc: Rumor says starlight rises from the Sunken-Star Marsh each night.
world.lead.temple_path.name: The Way to the Temple
world.lead.temple_path.desc: The old ferryman has shown the way to the sunken temple.
world.lead.vault_gate.name: The Nine-Star Gate
world.lead.vault_gate.desc: The temple's stone door answered the tally and one star lit.
world.lead.elder_advisor.name: Elder Mo Travels With You
world.lead.elder_advisor.desc: Elder Mo has laid down the village watch and travels with you as an advisor.
world.lead.elder_seal_lead.name: Elder Mo's Seal
world.lead.elder_seal_lead.desc: Elder Mo left an old seal; the valley's future is yours to decide.
minigame.mining.title: Mining
minigame.mining.help: A marker sweeps the rock face. Tap as it crosses the glowing vein. Five strikes; the closer the better.
minigame.music.title: Music
minigame.music.help: Notes drift toward the gold line. Tap as each one arrives; the closer the better.
event.y2_new_year.title: New Year
event.y2_new_year.live.1: Happy New Year. Every night since you left, I kept the lamp at the gate lit.
event.y2_new_year.live.2: Take this, a small gift. The road is long; do not go hungry.
event.y2_new_year.adv.1: A new year. These old bones do not mind seeing it in on the road.
event.y2_new_year.adv.2: When you are unsure of something, ask me first.
event.y2_new_year.seal.1: On New Year's night there are fewer lamps in the village than before. You hold Elder Mo's old seal in your palm.
event.y2_new_year.seal.2: Under the seal runs a line of small characters, in the same hand as the one on your tally.
world.lead.seal_inscription.name: The Inscription Under the Seal
world.lead.seal_inscription.desc: Under Elder Mo's seal is a line in the same hand as the jade tally.
event.y2_black_banner.title: The Black Banner
event.y2_black_banner.1: A black banner with a grey edge hangs at the market entrance, no characters on it. Vendors lower their voices: the old magistrate was transferred last night.
event.y2_black_banner.2: The new magistrate stands on the steps, smiling pleasantly. "From now on, someone will worry about the market on everyone's behalf."
event.y2_black_banner.3: He speaks in the same calm as the masked rider that night.
event.y2_black_banner.c.probe: Slip into the crowd and watch who stands beside him
event.y2_xia_zhi.title: The Shadow in the Alley
event.y2_xia_zhi.1: In the night alley a grey-purple shadow drops from the eaves, fingers already hooked on the half tally at your hip.
event.y2_xia_zhi.2: "Don't shout!" the girl whispers, flipping her wrist so a dagger rests against your cord. "Lend me that for one night."
event.y2_xia_zhi.3: I clamp her wrist. "It is not for lending."
event.y2_xia_zhi.c.bargain: Let go and ask why she wants it
event.y2_xia_zhi.c.follow: Let her go and follow quietly
event.y2_house_replaced.title: A New Master for the Guild
event.y2_house_replaced.1: The talk in the teahouse is hotter than the tea: the Barge Guild master stepped down last night, ill, and his successor is someone nobody has heard of.
event.y2_house_replaced.2: The new master bows on the upper floor. "From today the guild's barges carry only goods with a pass."
event.y2_house_replaced.3: A pass, from whom? Nobody can say.
event.y2_barge_riot.title: Riot on the Docks
event.y2_barge_riot.1: Goods without a pass are seized on the docks; the porters surround the new master's men and hired thugs draw their clubs.
event.y2_barge_riot.2: The old master's loyalists nod to you from the crowd; the meaning is plain: you are needed here.
event.y2_hui_letter.title: Grey Wax
event.y2_hui_letter.1: Before the cave wall lies an unsigned letter, sealed with grey wax.
event.y2_hui_letter.2: "In Yanmen to the north, someone waits for a jade tally. You need not trust me. Only go and see."
event.y2_hui_letter.3: The hand shakes a little, as if the writer had not held a brush in a long time.
event.arc_xie_wujiu_2.title: Wax in the Ashes
event.arc_xie_wujiu_2.1: "I found something." Xie Wujiu sets a charred scrap on the stone table. "That night someone burned papers in the library."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_2.2: "There is grey wax in the ash." He looks at you. "Is that the same sort as the masked one you spoke of?"
event.arc_xie_wujiu_2.3: I nod. This is bigger than one man's wrong.
event.ry5_market_patrol.title: Passes Checked
event.ry5_market_patrol.1: Grey-clad men check passes on the market street while traders swallow their anger.
event.ry5_market_rumor.title: The Missing Records
event.ry5_market_rumor.1: The sugar-figure seller says: "The day the new magistrate arrived, the old records vanished overnight."
event.ry5_docks_pass.title: Porters in Line
event.ry5_docks_pass.1: Porters queue for passes; you spend half a day carrying goods for an old man.
event.ry5_docks_barge.title: Empty Barges
event.ry5_docks_barge.1: Guild barges sit empty at the quay, boatmen smoking on deck.
event.ry5_alley_patrol.title: Alley Inspection
event.ry5_alley_patrol.1: A lantern flares at the alley mouth and grey-clad men bar the way. "Routine inspection."
event.ry5_alley_cat.title: The Cat on the Roof
event.ry5_alley_cat.1: A tabby on the eaves stares at you, flicks its tail and bolts along the roof ridge.
event.ry5_teahouse_talk.title: News from the North
event.ry5_teahouse_talk.1: Guests at the next table talk about the northern border: Yanmen has been uneasy lately.
event.ry5_pawn_visit.title: Qian's Whisper
event.ry5_pawn_visit.1: Shopkeeper Qian lowers his voice: "Of ten people pawning things lately, seven are on the grey men's side."
combat.scenario.y2_barge_riot.objective: Drive off the four hired thugs.
combat.scenario.y2_patrol.objective: Beat back the three grey patrolmen.
combat.scenario.y2_xia_catch.objective: Subdue the girl who tried to take the tally.
ability.shadow_step.desc: A strike slipped in from the dark, range 3.
ability.backstab.desc: Extra damage against a broken enemy.
ability.vanish.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): move 4 extra cells this turn.
companion.xia_zhi.bio: A girl raised inside the Faceless Gate: fast, sharp-tongued and soft underneath.
event.arc_xia_zhi_1.title: Sweets on the Roof Ridge
event.arc_xia_zhi_1.1: "Why didn't you hit me?" Xia Zhi squats on the roof ridge chewing a sweet. "They say whoever gets caught never gets a second chance."
event.arc_xia_zhi_1.2: "They"? She does not say who. Only: "Someone pays a lot for that tally. I do not want to take it, but I cannot say I don't want to."
event.arc_xia_zhi_1.3: I hold out a hand. "Then don't take it yet. Come down and eat something hot."
world.lead.gate_banner.name: The Black Banner
world.lead.gate_banner.desc: The black banner has no writing, and the new magistrate speaks as calmly as the masked man.
world.lead.xia_orders.name: Xia Zhi's Orders
world.lead.xia_orders.desc: Someone paid well for your tally and sent a girl to steal it.
world.lead.guild_replaced.name: The Guild's New Master
world.lead.guild_replaced.desc: The Barge Guild master stepped down ill; nobody knows where his successor came from.
world.lead.riot_witness.name: Seen on the Docks
world.lead.riot_witness.desc: During the dock riot you saw a grey veil among the new master's men.
world.lead.yanmen_road.name: The Road to Yanmen
world.lead.yanmen_road.desc: The Hui-Mask's letter says someone in Yanmen waits for a jade tally.
world.lead.grey_wax.name: Grey Wax
world.lead.grey_wax.desc: Grey wax in the library ashes matches the Hui-Mask's seal.
world.lead.gate_orders.name: Orders of the Gate
world.lead.gate_orders.desc: The Faceless Gate sent Xia Zhi, though she does not want to take the tally.
world.area.ym_fort.name: Yanmen Fort
world.area.ym_fort.desc: A fort of grey stone, its red banners snapped straight by the wind.
world.area.ym_fort.w1: You watch the garrison change at the foot of the wall, drumbeats in perfect unison.
world.area.ym_fort.w2: An old soldier shares a bowl of hot wine with you.
world.area.ym_road.name: Caravan Road
world.area.ym_road.desc: The caravan road to the fort, ice thin in the wheel ruts.
world.area.ym_road.w1: You push wagons for a caravan half a day and earn a few coppers.
world.area.ym_road.w2: In a roadside post-house men murmur about movements beyond the pass.
world.area.ym_pass.name: Snow Pass
world.area.ym_pass.desc: A narrow cut between two peaks, snow to the shin.
world.area.ym_pass.w1: You stand a while in the wind, drawing long steady breaths.
world.area.ym_pass.w2: An old arrowhead shows in the snow, left from last winter.
world.area.ym_field.name: Old Battlefield
world.area.ym_field.desc: Open ground beyond the walls; broken spears still show beneath the dead grass.
world.area.ym_field.w1: You walk among the broken spears, heavy at heart.
world.area.ym_field.w2: Someone sings an old marching song in the wind, too faint to follow.
event.y2_road_north.title: Storm on the Caravan Road
event.y2_road_north.1: The storm on the caravan road comes fast. The wagons ahead halt and drivers heave their carts out of a ditch with shouted rhythms.
event.y2_road_north.2: "Heading into the fort, friend? Yanmen is uneasy lately; the garrison checks even caravans three times."
event.y2_road_north.3: The tally grows cold in my coat. This must be the place the Hui-Mask's letter meant.
event.y2_road_north.c.push: Push on to the fort through the storm
event.y2_xiao_hanchuan.title: Questioned at the Gate
event.y2_xiao_hanchuan.1: On the gate steps a young man in black-and-silver mail bars your way. His heavy sabre stays sheathed, yet his gaze is colder than steel.
event.y2_xiao_hanchuan.2: "Xiao Hanchuan. Duty of the Yanmen garrison: anyone entering with arms must show where they come from."
event.y2_xiao_hanchuan.3: "And that half jade at your breast: what is it?"
event.y2_xiao_hanchuan.c.spar: "If you want proof, test me with your hands"
event.y2_fort_orders.title: Hold Position
event.y2_fort_orders.1: The camp drums sound three times at midnight, yet no company leaves the barracks.
event.y2_fort_orders.2: "Orders from above: three villages beyond the pass are being raided and the garrison is to hold position, not to leave the fort." His knuckles whiten on the scabbard.
event.y2_fort_orders.3: "I do not understand it. Tell me, what sense is there in this?"
event.y2_fort_orders.c.tell: Tell him what the Hui-Mask's letter said
event.y2_fort_orders.c.watch: Say nothing and go look beyond the pass yourself
event.y2_snow_pass.title: Escort Through the Snow
event.y2_snow_pass.1: The wind in the snow pass cuts like a knife. In the hollow ahead, grey-clad men are tying ropes onto a caravan's sleds.
event.y2_snow_pass.2: "Help! They mean to take the whole caravan's goods!"
event.y2_pass_battle.title: The Battle for the Pass
event.y2_pass_battle.1: Before dawn the horn beyond the fort sounds three times. A grey tide pours down from the snow ridge, aimed straight at the gate.
event.y2_pass_battle.2: "The garrison may not leave the fort." Xiao Hanchuan draws his heavy sabre, looking at you. "No one said I could not stand beside you."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_1.title: Orders and the Valley Below
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_1.1: "My father commands this fort," Xiao Hanchuan says on the wall, snow settling on his mail. "He taught me an order is a mountain. But below the mountain, people are bleeding."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_1.3: "Because your blade should be drawn for the people it guards."
event.arc_su_dai_2.title: The Second Verse
event.arc_su_dai_2.1: "Listen!" Su Dai stills her pipa. "The old musician in the caravan knows the second verse of my mother's song."
event.arc_su_dai_2.2: "'Geese return beyond the pass, seek the star by lamplight'... that is a place." She looks up, her eyes bright as snow-glare. "Will you come with me?"
event.arc_li_shan_2.title: Northern Iron
event.arc_li_shan_2.1: "Northern iron is good," Li Shan says, crouched by an ore cart, knocking a chunk with his knuckle. "The ore in my furnace came from here."
event.arc_li_shan_2.2: "The fire was lit so nobody would see this ore." He sets the chunk back. "Someone in the north is digging what should not be dug."
event.ry6_fort_drill.title: Garrison Drill
event.ry6_fort_drill.1: On the drill ground the garrison trains, blades flashing in a line over the snow.
event.ry6_fort_mess.title: Hot Soup in the Mess
event.ry6_fort_mess.1: The mess veteran passes a hot bowl: "Drink. Before a fight the main thing is not to be hungry."
event.ry6_road_wagon.title: Pushing the Wagon
event.ry6_road_wagon.1: A wagon is stuck in the snow; you and the driver heave it clear.
event.ry6_road_tale.title: The Old Driver's Tale
event.ry6_road_tale.1: An old driver tells of Yanmen's past: "This wall was built on the names of fallen brothers."
event.ry6_pass_wind.title: Footwork in the Wind
event.ry6_pass_wind.1: The mountain wind can barely be stood against, and you work a footwork set along with it.
event.ry6_pass_hunt.title: Hunting a Hare
event.ry6_pass_hunt.1: Hare tracks cross the snow; you follow them half a day and bring one back.
event.ry6_field_spears.title: Spears for Markers
event.ry6_field_spears.1: You push broken spears back into the earth, a ring of markers for the nameless.
event.ry6_field_song.title: Song on the Wind
event.ry6_field_song.1: The marching song comes nearer, and you catch one line: 'Never abandon a comrade.'
combat.scenario.y2_pass_battle.objective: Beat back every attacker beyond the fort.
ability.rally_cry.desc: A command that restores 5 resolve to an ally, range 3.
ability.sabre_counter.desc: A heavy close strike that knocks the enemy back.
ability.garrison_order.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): 2 extra cells and 6 resolve restored.
companion.xiao_hanchuan.bio: The garrison commander's son: duty like a mountain, cold outside and warm within, with a border on his shoulders.
world.lead.fort_road.name: The Road to the Fort
world.lead.fort_road.desc: The caravan road ends at Yanmen Fort, where the garrison checks everyone.
world.lead.fort_trust.name: Xiao's Trust
world.lead.fort_trust.desc: You showed Xiao Hanchuan the tally and he kept it quiet.
world.lead.field_raids.name: Raids Beyond the Pass
world.lead.field_raids.desc: The garrison is ordered to stay in the fort while three villages beyond are raided in turn.
world.lead.pass_raiders.name: Raiders in the Snow
world.lead.pass_raiders.desc: The raiders in the snow wear grey cloth bands like the Faceless Gate.
world.lead.garrison_orders.name: The Mystery of the Orders
world.lead.garrison_orders.desc: Who is keeping the Yanmen garrison from leaving the fort?
world.lead.song_second_verse.name: The Second Verse
world.lead.song_second_verse.desc: 'Geese return beyond the pass, seek the star by lamplight': Su Dai's song points to a place.
world.lead.northern_ore.name: Northern Iron
world.lead.northern_ore.desc: The burned ore came from the north.
world.area.pd_harbour.name: Penglai Harbour
world.area.pd_harbour.desc: A crescent harbour where shell lanterns go out one by one in the morning mist.
world.area.pd_harbour.w1: You haul nets with fishermen half a day and earn a basket of catch.
world.area.pd_harbour.w2: An old sailor teaches you to read the tide's sound, 'the sea speaking'.
world.area.pd_cave.name: Coral Cave
world.area.pd_cave.desc: A cave bared by the ebbing tide, its ceiling rippling with light.
world.area.pd_cave.w1: You sit in the cave listening to drops fall on coral.
world.area.pd_cave.w2: A few pearl-sized ore grains are wedged in the tide cracks.
world.area.pd_monastery.name: Lighthouse Monastery
world.area.pd_monastery.desc: A white tower on the cliff whose lamp the whole isle sees at night.
world.area.pd_monastery.w1: You copy half a scroll under the eaves, salt wind in every line.
world.area.pd_monastery.w2: The tower monk offers you a cup of hot tea.
event.y2_guild_ship.title: A Ship to the East
event.y2_guild_ship.1: At the end of the docks lies an unflagged sea ship. An old guild hand says quietly: "She sails tomorrow for Penglai in the east."
event.y2_guild_ship.2: "The Hui-Mask sent word through a friend: there is a star beneath Penglai's lighthouse."
event.y2_guild_ship.c.work: Work your passage as a deckhand
event.y2_crossing.title: Storm at Sea
event.y2_crossing.1: The wind turns at midnight. The mast creaks and waves slam the deck again and again.
event.y2_crossing.2: "The gale's up! Some furl the sails, some bail, the rest hold fast to the ropes!"
event.y2_crossing.c.rope: Hold the rope and steady the others
event.y2_yun_mian.title: The Lamp Keeper
event.y2_yun_mian.1: On the monastery porch a woman with wave-like hair watches the sea. The lamp behind her has gone out.
event.y2_yun_mian.2: "Yun Mian, keeper of Penglai's lamp." She does not turn. "The jade at your breast glows once every seven days. Do you know why?"
event.y2_yun_mian.3: "I do not ask where you came from. I ask only: if you gather all nine stars, what will you do with them?"
event.y2_yun_mian.c.protect: Guard them so nobody can use them
event.y2_yun_mian.c.mend: Use them to mend the torn martial world
event.y2_coral_cave.title: The Second Star
event.y2_coral_cave.1: At the lowest tide a star-shaped jade fragment set in the rock shows deep in the coral cave, glowing cold in the dark.
event.y2_coral_cave.2: The second star. The tally burns at my breast as if answering it.
event.y2_coral_cave.c.leave: Leave it and take a rubbing of its pattern
event.y2_trial_breakthrough.title: The Hermit Trial
event.y2_trial_breakthrough.1: "The hermit rule: to cross the next door, first pass me." Yun Mian trims the wick. "Not for victory or defeat, only so I may see your flame."
event.y2_trial_breakthrough.2: I set my pack beneath the eaves and clench my fists.
event.y2_ship_back.title: Intercepted at Sea
event.y2_ship_back.1: The ship has barely left harbour when three unflagged fast boats close in, their bows crowded with grey-clad men.
event.y2_ship_back.2: "They want what is at your breast!" The old sailor whitens his knuckles on the helm. "You to the deck, I will hold the ship!"
event.arc_xia_zhi_2.title: Tonight's Errand
event.arc_xia_zhi_2.1: "I have carried messages for them," Xia Zhi says, leaning on the wall without looking at you. "They gave me food, a roof, and a name."
event.arc_xia_zhi_2.2: "Tonight they want me to fetch something. Guess what." At last she looks up. "I want you to choose for me."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_2.title: A Four-Word Reply
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_2.1: "I wrote a letter to my father," Xiao Hanchuan says, pressing a folded page under his scabbard. "Asking why we hold position."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_2.2: "The reply was four words: 'An order is a mountain.'" He smiles wryly. "For the first time in my life I do not know which side the mountain is on."
event.ry7_harbour_nets.title: Hauling Nets
event.ry7_harbour_nets.1: Fishermen's hauling chants rise and fall and you lend a hand.
event.ry7_harbour_pirates.title: Harbour Brawl
event.ry7_harbour_pirates.1: A few pirate-dressed men block a shell-selling child on the quay, reaching to grab his basket.
event.ry7_harbour_tale.title: Why the Lamp Burns
event.ry7_harbour_tale.1: The old sailor says: "Every lamp in Penglai's tower used to be lit for ships that had lost their way."
event.ry7_cave_pearls.title: Ore in the Tide
event.ry7_cave_pearls.1: You find smooth stones in the tide cracks; held to the light they are fine ore grains.
event.ry7_cave_echo.title: Breathing in the Cave
event.ry7_cave_echo.1: The cave's echo smells of water; you breathe in rhythm with it for an hour.
event.ry7_monastery_sweep.title: Sweeping the Tower Court
event.ry7_monastery_sweep.1: The tower monk hands you a bamboo broom and you sweep leaves half the day.
event.ry7_monastery_copy.title: Copying the Sea-Chant
event.ry7_monastery_copy.1: You copy a sea-chant for the monks, tide marks in the margins.
event.ry7_monastery_tea.title: Sea-Salt Tea
event.ry7_monastery_tea.1: The monk brews salt-sea tea, bitter and briny, and you feel refreshed after it.
combat.scenario.y2_hermit_trial.objectiv: Hold your ground before Yun Mian.
combat.scenario.y2_sea_ambush.objective: Hold the deck and beat off every raider.
combat.scenario.y2_harbour_brawl.objecti: Chase off the three pirate-dressed robbers.
world.lead.penglai_route.name: The Sea Route East
world.lead.penglai_route.desc: An old guild ship sails unflagged for Penglai in the east.
world.lead.hermit_trials.name: The Hermit Trials
world.lead.hermit_trials.desc: Yun Mian will see your flame before you cross the next door.
world.lead.fragment_two.name: The Second Star
world.lead.fragment_two.desc: A second Nine-Star fragment is set in the coral cave.
world.lead.hermit_blessing.name: The Lamp's Regard
world.lead.hermit_blessing.desc: Yun Mian has acknowledged your flame by the lamp.
world.lead.gate_errand.name: Xia Zhi's Errand
world.lead.gate_errand.desc: The Faceless Gate wants Xia Zhi to fetch something tonight.
world.lead.fathers_reply.name: A Four-Word Reply
world.lead.fathers_reply.desc: The general's reply is four words: an order is a mountain.
realm.blocked.hermit: The hermit trial is not yet passed
event.y2_council.title: The Council of Houses
event.y2_council.1: Long tables fill the teahouse's upper floor and each house has sent an envoy. Some pound the table, some are silent, and the Jade Accord fragments are pushed back and forth.
event.y2_council.2: Qian Man leans to your ear: "For the first time since the Accord, no house trusts another. Whichever side you stand on, you will answer to that side's ledger."
event.y2_council.c.orthodox: Stand with Cangwu and the orthodox houses
event.y2_council.c.trade: Stand with the guilds and couriers
event.arc_xie_wujiu_3.title: Face to Face
event.arc_xie_wujiu_3.1: "The proof is enough." Xie Wujiu lays a stack of pages on the stone table. "I can lay it out before the master and the whole mountain, shaming Gu Xingzhou. Or I can hand it to him quietly and let him mend it himself."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_3.c.public: Do it in public; I will stand by you
event.arc_xie_wujiu_3.c.quiet: Hand it to the master quietly
event.arc_xie_wujiu_3.c.drop: Let it go and leave Cangwu
event.arc_su_dai_3.title: The Song and the Map
event.arc_su_dai_3.1: "I have pieced the map together," Su Dai says softly, holding her pipa. "It points to the third star. Someone has offered a whole courtyard for every verse of this song."
event.arc_su_dai_3.2: "I want to hide it. Yet I want it to be heard. What do you say?"
event.arc_su_dai_3.c.share: Teach it to the whole street so nobody can own it
event.arc_su_dai_3.c.hide: Hide it, known to you alone
event.arc_li_shan_3.title: Two Ways to Light the Forge
event.arc_li_shan_3.1: "A chest of gold arrived," Li Shan says before the new furnace frame. "No name, only that I forge a batch of blades for them."
event.arc_li_shan_3.2: "Without the gold the furnace can still be lit. Only slower."
event.arc_li_shan_3.c.together: We build it brick by brick together
event.arc_li_shan_3.c.small: Start a small stall and go slowly
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.title: To Take or Not to Take
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.1: "At midnight tonight I must bring the tally," Xia Zhi says, dagger hanging at her side. "Or they will go after my little brother."
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.2: "I could fail on purpose. I could really take it. Or I could go with you."
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.c.defect: Come with me; we will bring him out too
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.c.fake: Fake a failure and buy a few days
event.arc_xia_zhi_3.c.steal: Do not force yourself; take it
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.title: The Order and the People
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.1: "The order has come," Xiao Hanchuan says flatly. "The garrison holds position. Violators face military law."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.2: "The villages beyond the pass will burn again tonight. I mean to take men out. Will you come?"
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.c.break: I go with you; we break out
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.c.petition: Draft a joint petition and find another way
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_3.c.obey: Urge him to obey and protect himself
event.y2_betrayal.title: The Betrayal
event.y2_betrayal.xia.1: A folded note is left in the alley in crooked writing: "I am sorry, they took someone. - Zhi"
event.y2_betrayal.xia.2: I clutch the note. She has not gone far; she was dragged into the dark.
event.y2_betrayal.xie.1: A messenger outside the library says Xie Wujiu received a letter sealed with grey wax and has gone down the mountain.
event.y2_betrayal.xie.2: He has been pushed to the end of his rope. I cannot let him go down alone.
event.y2_betrayal.gate.1: After the council a page is missing from the teahouse ledger, one only an insider could touch.
event.y2_betrayal.gate.2: Someone is passing word among us. I must find him first.
event.y2_rescue.title: Rescue at the Warehouse
event.y2_rescue.1: You track them to a ruined warehouse in the west of the city. A lamp glows within and a dozen grey-clad men guard a bound figure.
event.y2_rescue.2: This time I will not let anyone be taken from my side.
event.y2_solstice.title: The Second Solstice
event.y2_solstice.1: A second Winter Solstice: there are a few more lamps in the village than last year. The farther you go, the more precious they seem.
event.y2_solstice.2: Whom do you share the hot soup with tonight?
event.y2_winter_end.title: Winter of the Second Year
event.y2_winter_end.1: The second year's snow blankets the valley. Two stars are found, and the places of three fragments now line up on the map.
event.y2_winter_end.2: A paper with grey wax lies pressed in the snow: "The marsh gate has a second door. The key is where the last gathering is held."
event.y2_winter_end.3: The Sword-Debate Platform. The gathering held once in three years, next year.
event.ry8_village_snow.title: Snow in the Village
event.ry8_village_snow.1: Snow whispers on bamboo leaves, and children at the gate chase after you calling you hero.
event.ry8_teahouse_split.title: Two Camps of Tea Drinkers
event.ry8_teahouse_split.1: Tea drinkers split into two camps, each murmuring, neither glancing at the other.
event.ry8_courts_empty.title: Empty Courts
event.ry8_courts_empty.1: The courts are half empty; Cangwu's disciples are called to guard the gate.
event.ry8_fort_watch.title: The Password at Night
event.ry8_fort_watch.1: Sentries on the wall change three times and the password is altered twice in one night.
event.ry8_harbour_lamp.title: The Sweeping Lamp
event.ry8_harbour_lamp.1: The lighthouse beam sweeps the water and you sit on the quay a long while.
event.ry8_market_gossip.title: Rumours of the Accord
event.ry8_market_gossip.1: Vendors all talk of the Accord, saying the platform gathering may not be held this year.
combat.scenario.y2_public_proof.objectiv: Defeat the Cangwu senior who bars the way.
combat.scenario.y2_break_ranks.objective: Defeat the garrison sabremen who block the gate.
combat.scenario.y2_rescue.objective: Beat off the grey guards and free the captive.
world.lead.houses_split.name: The Houses Split
world.lead.houses_split.desc: The council of houses broke up in discord; the Accord's hold has loosened.
world.lead.vault_second_gate.name: The Second Gate
world.lead.vault_second_gate.desc: The marsh vault has a second gate and its key lies at the Sword-Debate Platform.
world.lead.platform_year3.name: The Platform Gathering
world.lead.platform_year3.desc: The triennial gathering at the Sword-Debate Platform comes next year.
event.y3_new_year.title: The First Day of the Third Year
event.y3_new_year.orth.1: On the first day of the third year an invitation from Cangwu arrives early, written in a neat hand, each phrase measuring you.
event.y3_new_year.orth.2: "The platform gathering is this year." You seem to hear Elder Mo at your ear. "Whatever side you stand on, remember you are of Jade Valley."
event.y3_new_year.trade.1: On the first day of the third year the Barge Guild sends a cart of gifts, every item ledgered, even the price of a return gift noted.
event.y3_new_year.trade.2: "Favour and accounts are two separate books," you seem to hear Elder Mo say. "Do not mix them up."
event.y3_new_year.free.1: On the first day of the third year there is no invitation and no gift. You keep the vigil alone, the bamboo ticking as snow bends the branches.
event.y3_new_year.free.2: "If you answer to no ledger, nobody keeps yours," you seem to hear Elder Mo chuckle. "You must walk your own road."
event.y3_gate_opens.title: The Grey Banner
event.y3_gate_opens.1: Whispers fill the teahouse. Overnight the lock of the old Barge Guild hall was changed and a blank grey banner hangs over its lintel.
event.y3_gate_opens.2: Qian Man lowers his voice: "The Faceless Gate has stopped hiding its face. They want the whole city to see it."
event.y3_gate_opens.3: If it is out in the open, it can be ended in the open.
event.y3_house_summons.title: The Platform Summons
event.y3_house_summons.1: Alliance Head Lei Zhenyue's token reaches the teahouse: each of the nine houses is to send a delegate and settle the platform's rules at Cangwu's foot before spring.
event.y3_house_summons.2: "Three tables are being laid," Qian Man counts on his fingers. "One orthodox, one for the traders, and one left empty. Which will you sit at?"
event.y3_valley_returns.title: The Valley's Name
event.y3_valley_returns.fall.1: A-Fu comes with a pot of hot tea: "Hero, I sweep Elder Mo's grave every day. The bamboo grew especially well this year."
event.y3_valley_returns.fall.2: You stand at the grave a long while. The scrap of grey wax pressed behind the stone, you still have not the courage to look at again.
event.y3_valley_returns.fall.3: So the ninth house's name is carved right here.
event.y3_valley_returns.kept.1: A-Fu hollers from the doorway of the rebuilt inn: "The hero is back! Elder Mo has been brewing tea inside all afternoon waiting for you."
event.y3_valley_returns.kept.2: "Our line in Jade Valley," the old man says, pushing a cup to you, "is the ninth house. You ought to know its name by now."
event.y3_valley_returns.kept.3: I hold the hot tea, my palms hotter than the cup.
event.y3_valley_returns.away.1: A-Fu meets you at the gate: "Elder Mo has been away some time and left only a message with me."
event.y3_valley_returns.away.2: "Jade Valley is the ninth house." The note carries only this line, "Come home and see."
event.y3_valley_returns.away.3: The ninth house. I was always of it and learn its name only today.
event.y3_chi_mask.title: The Chi-Mask's Challenge
event.y3_chi_mask.1: The lanterns at the alley mouth go out one after another. A man in dark red robes leans on the wall, wearing half a crimson mask.
event.y3_chi_mask.2: "I have long heard of the heir of Jade Valley," he laughs softly. "The Xuan-Mask wants a scholar, the Hui-Mask wants fate, and I only want a good fight."
event.y3_chi_mask.3: "Last thirty moves against me and I will tell you what the key to the second gate looks like."
event.y3_border_burns.title: The Beacons Again
event.y3_border_burns.held.1: "You come at the right moment." Xiao Hanchuan wears his armour, eyes red. "My men led the villagers inside; one road is left beyond the pass."
event.y3_border_burns.held.2: Beacon smoke rises in the north. The veterans who broke ranks with him that day now stand behind you without being asked.
event.y3_border_burns.plain.1: "Yanmen cannot hold," Xiao Hanchuan says hoarsely. "Not one order has come from the reinforcements. I have only this fort and the people in it."
event.y3_border_burns.plain.2: Beacon smoke rises in the north and burns down to the snow below the walls.
event.y3_border_choice.title: Hold or Withdraw
event.y3_border_choice.1: "Hold the fort, or cover the villagers' retreat?" Xiao Hanchuan looks at you. "I will not press you. Whichever you choose, I fight it."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.title: The Courtyard
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.r.1: On the Cangwu courts Gu Xingzhou bows before the whole mountain to Xie Wujiu and holds out a teacher's token.
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.r.2: "They want me back as a teacher," Xie Wujiu says, turning the token in his palm. "I thought a long while and I would rather open a courtyard of my own at the valley's edge."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.r.3: "Thank you for the whole road." He looks at you. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.a.1: Gu Xingzhou admitted his fault in private and nobody else knows. Xie Wujiu stands outside the mountain gate, neither going in nor leaving.
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.a.2: "This will do," he says quietly. "If someone remembers the truth, that is enough."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.a.3: "Thank you for the whole road." He looks at you. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.l.1: Xie Wujiu folds his old red robe and sets it on the stone steps before the Cangwu gate.
event.arc_xie_wujiu_4.l.2: "I am leaving," he says without turning. "If we meet on a platform one day, do not hold back."
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.title: Daylight at the Alley Mouth
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.r.1: In the morning alley Xia Zhi leads a thin little boy who clutches a cold sesame cake.
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.r.2: "My little brother." For the first time her smile has no guard. "Listening-Rain Hall will take him to learn medicine. And I... no longer have to steal for anyone."
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.r.3: "Hey, don't look at me like that." She hops down. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.a.1: At the end of the alley Xia Zhi sits on a roof edge with her dagger on her knees. Three days have passed and nobody has come asking for the tally.
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.a.2: "It is not over," she says, looking down at you. "But I have decided. This time I choose your side."
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.a.3: "Hey, don't look at me like that." She hops down. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.l.1: In the night alley Xia Zhi stands behind the grey-clad men, her dagger gone into her sleeve. She does not look at you.
event.arc_xia_zhi_4.l.2: "The tally is in their hands now," she says softly. "I do not ask forgiveness. Next time we meet I will not hold back."
event.ry9_valley_planting.title: Planting
event.ry9_valley_planting.1: Spring rain has barely passed and villagers hurry to sow. A-Fu says there will be more bamboo shoots than ever.
event.ry9_market_grey.title: Grey Cloth on the Stalls
event.ry9_market_grey.1: A few market stalls hang grey strips of cloth. Asked why, the owners only shake their heads.
event.ry9_docks_search.title: Crates Searched
event.ry9_docks_search.1: Cargo on the docks is searched crate by crate by men who wear no uniform and show no papers.
event.ry9_courts_drill.title: Extra Drill
event.ry9_courts_drill.1: On the courts disciples drill extra hours, the commands coming one after another like a muster.
event.ry9_fort_supplies.title: Supplies
event.ry9_fort_supplies.1: Another tenth of the fort's stores is gone. The cook empties the last sack of rice into the pot without a word.
event.ry9_teahouse_song.title: A New Song
event.ry9_teahouse_song.1: Someone in the teahouse sings a newly written song about the Accord and the platform. The listeners are very quiet.
event.ry9_alley_cat.title: The Cat on the Wall
event.ry9_alley_cat.1: In the night alley a black cat crouches on a wall and watches you a long while before leaping into the dark.
event.ry9_harbour_news.title: News from the Isle
event.ry9_harbour_news.1: A ship brings news from the isle: the hermits' disciples have set out for Cangwu to see this platform gathering.
combat.scenario.y3_guild_hall.objective: Beat back the Gate elite who hold the hall.
combat.scenario.y3_chi_duel.objective: Last out the Chi-Mask's thirty moves.
combat.scenario.y3_border_defence.object: Hold the wall and drive off the attackers.
world.lead.gate_unmasked.name: The Gate Unmasked
world.lead.gate_unmasked.desc: The Faceless Gate hides its face no longer; its grey banner hangs over the old guild hall.
world.lead.platform_summons.name: The Platform Summons
world.lead.platform_summons.desc: Head Lei calls the nine houses to settle the platform's rules before spring.
world.lead.ninth_house.name: The Ninth House
world.lead.ninth_house.desc: The Jade Valley line is the Accord's ninth house.
world.lead.border_burns.name: Beacons in the North
world.lead.border_burns.desc: Beacons burn again at Yanmen, and the garrison waits for a decision.
world.area.sv_stair.name: The Vault Stair
world.area.sv_stair.desc: A stone stair runs down under the marsh into the dark, its walls carved with star charts you cannot read.
world.area.sv_stair.w1: A small chip of jade lies in a groove in the wall.
world.area.sv_stair.w2: You sit on the steps and learn the chart's pattern by heart.
world.area.sv_hall.name: The Star Hall
world.area.sv_hall.desc: Nine star stones are set in the round hall's dome and only seven still glow.
world.area.sv_hall.w1: You meditate beneath the star stones until your breath matches the vault's.
world.area.sv_hall.w2: A fallen lump of ore lies in a corner of the hall.
world.area.sv_door.name: The Tally Door
world.area.sv_door.desc: At the end of the hall stands a jade door with no handle and a groove shaped like half a tally.
world.area.sv_door.w1: You press a hand to the jade door and a faint echo answers.
world.area.sv_door.w2: An old copper coin is wedged in the door seam.
event.y3b_fragments.title: Counting the Stars
event.y3b_fragments.1: Rubbings of the nine stars lie spread across the table. The first hid in the Barge Guild's old ledgers, the second in Penglai's coral cave.
event.y3b_fragments.2: Bai Yan nudges a page. "The rest must be found through the stories of those near you: Su Dai's song, Li Shan's forge mark, and the pattern I have read out of the dark script these years."
event.y3b_fragments.3: Good. Start with people, then go to the vault.
event.y3b_star_song.title: The Star in the Song
event.y3b_star_song.1: "I finally sang the last verse right today," Su Dai says, plucking her pipa. "Listen: every note lands on a star's place."
event.y3b_star_song.2: When the pipa falls silent, the third star lights on the map.
event.y3b_star_forge.title: The Star Under the Furnace
event.y3b_star_forge.1: "There was an old iron slab under the furnace," Li Shan says, setting a dark plate in your hand. "Its pattern matches the star chart you showed me."
event.y3b_star_forge.2: The plate is cold, and in its grain lies the fourth star's place.
event.y3b_star_pattern.title: The Star in the Script
event.y3b_star_pattern.1: "The dark script reads through," Bai Yan says, eyes red with strain yet smiling. "This pattern is the fifth star's key."
event.y3b_star_pattern.2: He pushes a whole volume of notes across to you. The flyleaf bears a single word: star.
event.y3b_second_gate.title: The Second Gate
event.y3b_second_gate.1: At the stair's end a stone door bars the way. It carries two grooves, one shaped like half a tally, the other empty.
event.y3b_second_gate.2: Which groove does the half-tally in my robe belong to?
event.y3b_second_gate.3: A heavy breath sounds behind the door. Something inside has woken.
event.y3b_second_gate.c.tally: Fit the tally into the groove
event.y3b_xuan_mask.title: The Xuan-Mask's Offer
event.y3b_xuan_mask.1: In the Star Hall a man in a deep blue gown gazes up at the dome's stones. His mask covers only the part above the nose.
event.y3b_xuan_mask.2: "The ninth star stone has gone dark," he says without turning. "The Accord was born of chaos and breeds chaos in turn. Who do you think keeps the cycle going?"
event.y3b_xuan_mask.3: "Hold this manual with me and the realm can be quiet for three hundred years. Will you?"
event.y3b_xuan_mask.c.refuse: I will not work with you
event.y3b_xuan_mask.c.deceive: Pretend to agree and see what he wants
event.y3b_ninth_star.title: The Ninth Fragment
event.y3b_ninth_star.1: The jade door opens slowly to the half-tally. Beyond lies only a stone dais bearing the ninth fragment, its pages yellow yet free of any dust.
event.y3b_ninth_star.2: The Hui-Mask has appeared by the doorway. "What you read is how to rewrite the Accord. But the day the Accord was written was also a rewriting."
event.y3b_ninth_star.3: "I copied it for them countless times. Now I want to see how you would copy it."
event.y3b_vault_collapse.title: The Vault Collapses
event.y3b_vault_collapse.1: The dome gives a dull crack. The nine star stones go out one after another and grey-clad men pour down the way you came.
event.y3b_vault_collapse.2: What lies behind the door must not fall into their hands.
event.arc_su_dai_4.title: The Song of the Market
event.arc_su_dai_4.r.1: At the market gate children sing the old song to Su Dai's pipa. Passers-by stop, one by one, humming along softly.
event.arc_su_dai_4.r.2: "It is not only mine anymore," she says, fingers still on the strings. "That is fine. At last many people remember it."
event.arc_su_dai_4.r.3: "Hey, don't scowl." She tucks a loose strand behind her ear. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_su_dai_4.a.1: Late at night only one lamp burns in the teahouse. Su Dai holds her pipa and sings the song for you alone.
event.arc_su_dai_4.a.2: "The score stays with me and nobody takes it." She smiles. "What you keep is this trust of mine."
event.arc_su_dai_4.a.3: "Hey, don't scowl." She tucks a loose strand behind her ear. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_su_dai_4.l.1: At the market tea stall Su Dai slings her pipa over her shoulder without looking at you.
event.arc_su_dai_4.l.2: "A song sold is a song sold," she says quietly. "I will write a new one. When people next ask, I will sing it to them."
event.arc_li_shan_4.title: By the Furnace
event.arc_li_shan_4.r.1: The new furnace by the docks is lit. Li Shan hammers stroke by stroke, sparks scattering on his apron like crushed stars.
event.arc_li_shan_4.r.2: "We built the furnace together," he says, setting down the hammer. "Every piece that leaves it will carry a share of you."
event.arc_li_shan_4.r.3: "...What would you want to be to me?" He scratches his head, embarrassed. "I am clumsy with words. You say it."
event.arc_li_shan_4.a.1: At the small stall by the docks the fire burns low but steady. Li Shan talks slowly as he hammers.
event.arc_li_shan_4.a.2: "Slow is fine," he says, looking up. "Craft is something you simmer, and so are friends."
event.arc_li_shan_4.a.3: "...What would you want to be to me?" He scratches his head, embarrassed. "I am clumsy with words. You say it."
event.arc_li_shan_4.l.1: The new furnace is lit but the fire is not the kind you knew. Li Shan stands before it without raising his head.
event.arc_li_shan_4.l.2: "The blades are being forged for others," he says heavily. "I do not ask forgiveness. Let us each walk our own road."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.title: The Horns on the Wall
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.r.1: A new tune sounds from Yanmen's horns. Xiao Hanchuan stands on the wall in the black-and-silver armour of the garrison's commander.
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.r.2: "From now on no order will have me turn my back on the people," he says, looking at you. "You taught me that."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.r.3: "There is one thing I want to hear from your own mouth." He straightens. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.a.1: At the edge of Yanmen's drill ground Xiao Hanchuan folds half-approved petition and tucks it into his coat.
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.a.2: "Half is still a half," he says, his tone looser than before. "The rest we shall argue for slowly."
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.a.3: "There is one thing I want to hear from your own mouth." He straightens. "What would you be to me?"
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.l.1: On the snow fields outside Yanmen Xiao Hanchuan has taken off his silver armour and carries only his old sabre.
event.arc_xiao_hanchuan_4.l.2: "The order was kept and the people were not," he says, bowing to you. "That debt I will go and pay myself."
event.ry10_stair_echo.title: Echoes on the Stair
event.ry10_stair_echo.1: A faint echo comes from deep along the stair, like someone far off turning pages.
event.ry10_hall_glow.title: The Stones Breathe
event.ry10_hall_glow.1: The dome's seven stones brighten and dim as if breathing. You watch them a long while, holding your breath.
event.ry10_door_cold.title: The Door's Chill
event.ry10_door_cold.1: A chill seeps from the jade door and your fingertip feels as if pressed to a winter lake.
event.ry10_valley_gift.title: New Shoots
event.ry10_valley_gift.1: A-Fu sends a basket of new bamboo shoots, saying you should be well rested before the platform.
event.ry10_market_stars.title: Star Charts in the Street
event.ry10_market_stars.1: A vendor says someone has been drawing star charts on the street at night, for who knows whom.
event.ry10_courts_clash.title: Quarrel over Seats
event.ry10_courts_clash.1: On the courts two sets of disciples quarrel over platform seats until a senior pulls them apart.
event.ry10_docks_quiet.title: The Quiet Docks
event.ry10_docks_quiet.1: Half the guild's boats are missing today, and the docks are strangely quiet.
