event.ry10_fort_news.title: The North Wind
event.ry10_fort_news.1: An old soldier on the wall says the north wind came late this year and Yanmen's snow will likely fall only after the platform gathering.
combat.scenario.y3_vault_guardian.object: Defeat the guardian that woke behind the stone door.
combat.scenario.y3_vault_collapse.object: Hold the jade door against the grey men flooding in.
world.lead.manual_truth.name: The Truth of the Manual
world.lead.manual_truth.desc: Read whole, the nine fragments teach not a martial art but how to rewrite the Accord.
world.area.pg_steps.name: The Platform Steps
world.area.pg_steps.desc: Long white steps climb Cangwu's flank to the Sword-Debate Platform, each house's awning already raised along them.
world.area.pg_steps.w1: You watch disciples of every house come and go on the steps and memorise many faces.
world.area.pg_steps.w2: A tea stall by the steps sells cold cakes and you eat two.
world.area.pg_pavilions.name: The Platform Pavilions
world.area.pg_pavilions.desc: Below the platform a row of pavilions, one for each of the nine houses, their lanterns never out.
world.area.pg_pavilions.w1: You overhear envoys murmuring in the pavilions.
world.area.pg_pavilions.w2: A half-burnt fine incense stick still smoulders in a corner censer.
event.y3c_alliances.title: Canvassing
event.y3c_alliances.1: In the pavilions all three camps are canvassing. The orthodox houses want your name, the traders want your road of coin, and some only want to know whether you will take a side at all.
event.y3c_alliances.2: Qian Man smiles courteously. "The platform's Head is chosen by the nine houses' votes. The one in your hand belongs to Jade Valley, not to you alone."
event.y3c_alliances.c.free: Pledge to none and keep the vote
event.y3c_gate_agents.title: Tampering in the Beams
event.y3c_gate_agents.1: Below the steps, several men dressed as labourers are stuffing something into an awning's beams. You know the gesture; it is the Faceless Gate's.
event.y3c_gate_agents.2: The platform has not even opened and they already want to tamper.
event.y3c_gate_agents.c.report: Report to Head Lei and watch quietly
event.y3c_midautumn.title: The Third Mid-Autumn
event.y3c_midautumn.1: Mid-Autumn of the third year: the moon is big as a bronze mirror. A table of mooncakes is set at the village gate, and A-Fu says this is the last reunion night before the platform.
event.y3c_midautumn.2: To whom do you hand the first mooncake?
event.y3c_midautumn.c.valley: The old friends: Shen, Lu and Bai
event.y3c_midautumn.c.fighters: The comrades: Xie, Li and Xiao
event.y3c_midautumn.c.street: The street companions: Su Dai and Xia Zhi
event.y3c_midautumn.c.all: Everyone around one table, one each
event.y3c_lei_head.title: Head Lei's Word
event.y3c_lei_head.1: Head Lei Zhenyue sits at the pavilions' far end, his temples gone white. His tea has been cold a long time and he has not touched it.
event.y3c_lei_head.2: "I will not contend for the seat again," he says, looking at you. "The Accord was mine to keep for twenty years, and for twenty years it kept me."
event.y3c_lei_head.3: "You may take it, or find a better hand for it. Only do not do as I did and mistake it for your fate."
event.y3c_lei_head.c.stay: Ask him to hold on a while longer
event.y3c_lei_head.c.other: I will find someone else for it
event.y3c_masks_offer.title: The Masks' Last Offers
event.y3c_masks_offer.1: On the dusk steps three people stand before you one after another, each saying only a single sentence.
event.y3c_masks_offer.2: Xuan-Mask: "I offer you a realm without war. The price is that it belongs to no one."
event.y3c_masks_offer.3: Chi-Mask: "I offer you a blade sharp enough, and whoever stands in your way, cut them down."
event.y3c_masks_offer.4: Hui-Mask: "I offer you a door with nobody waiting behind it. You can simply walk away."
event.y3c_cliff_trial.title: The Cliff Trial
event.y3c_cliff_trial.1: On the broken cliff behind Cangwu Gu Xingzhou stands alone in the wind. The wall behind him bears the trial marks made before every platform gathering.
event.y3c_cliff_trial.2: "Before the platform I must see your sword," he says, dropping his blade to the ground. "Not who is faster, but whether you can still stand firm on the cliff's edge."
event.y3c_cliff_trial.c.sit: Sit on the cliff edge a whole night
event.y3c_vigil.title: The Night Before
event.y3c_vigil.1: The night before the platform opens the pavilions are, for once, silent. Those who walked with you come one by one and sit beside you.
event.y3c_vigil.2: Someone wipes a blade, someone tunes a string, someone only watches the stars.
event.y3c_vigil.c.alone: Walk alone beneath the platform and look at the moon
event.ry11_steps_vendors.title: Stalls on the Steps
event.ry11_steps_vendors.1: Temporary stalls line the steps selling tea, cakes and pennants, hawkers' cries rolling up the slope.
event.ry11_pavilion_lanterns.title: Hanging the Lanterns
event.ry11_pavilion_lanterns.1: Lanterns are hung in the pavilions one after another, each carrying a house's name.
event.ry11_courts_ranks.title: The Registration Queue
event.ry11_courts_ranks.1: Disciples of every sect are registering on the courts and the long table's queue stretches far.
event.ry11_teahouse_odds.title: Odds on the Head
event.ry11_teahouse_odds.1: Tea drinkers lay bets on who will be Head, the odds chalked on a small blackboard.
event.ry11_valley_letters.title: Letters from Everywhere
event.ry11_valley_letters.1: A-Fu receives a stack of letters from everywhere, all wishing you well at the platform.
event.ry11_docks_pilgrims.title: The Travellers
event.ry11_docks_pilgrims.1: The docks are crowded with pilgrims and escorts heading for Cangwu, ferry after ferry.
combat.scenario.y3_gate_agents.objective: Seize the Gate's agents tampering with the awnings.
combat.scenario.y3_cliff_trial.objective: Withstand all of the trial swordsman's moves on the cliff's edge.
realm.blocked.cliff: The cliff trial is not yet passed
world.area.pg_platform.name: The Sword-Debate Platform
world.area.pg_platform.desc: A white stone platform three zhang square, nine pillars at its edges, each carved with a house's name.
world.area.pg_platform.w1: You stand at the edge and watch the wind blow every house's banner the same way.
world.area.pg_platform.w2: An old token lies under a pillar, its letters worn smooth.
event.y3d_arrivals.title: The Houses Arrive
event.y3d_arrivals.orth.1: White robes line the Cangwu road like snow. Orthodox disciples stand to either side and salute you, every courtesy exact.
event.y3d_arrivals.orth.2: Qian Man squeezes through the crowd to your side. "Nine in ten orthodox votes are yours. But they want more than a Head."
event.y3d_arrivals.trade.1: Banners flutter along the road as the guild and courier wagons roll in one after another. The traders have written your name in their ledgers.
event.y3d_arrivals.trade.2: Qian Man counts silver, grinning. "The traders' votes are yours. Mind you, accounts always come due."
event.y3d_arrivals.free.1: Every house's awning flies a banner, but at the foot of the steps stands a single chair with none. Some look at it and some walk around.
event.y3d_arrivals.free.2: Qian Man spreads his hands. "You took nobody's vote and nobody can take yours. This time you stand entirely alone."
event.y3d_platform_open.title: The Platform Opens
event.y3d_platform_open.1: Lei Zhenyue stands in the middle of the platform and says, in a voice with no force left in it: "The platform is open."
event.y3d_platform_open.2: The first round is a bracket. Each house sends fighters; the loser steps down, the winner stays. Your name is on the draw.
event.y3d_platform_open.3: "With your vote you may stay off the stage and watch from below," Qian Man murmurs. "But those who watch from below often cannot see the stage."
event.y3d_platform_open.c.stands: Stay in the stands and watch the whole
event.y3d_returned.title: An Old Companion
event.y3d_returned.xie.1: At the foot of the steps a man in an old red robe sits with a spear across his knees. It is Xie Wujiu.
event.y3d_returned.xie.2: "As agreed, no holding back when we meet on a platform." He rises, spear point to the ground. "Come."
event.y3d_returned.xia.1: On the pavilion eaves crouches a grey-violet shadow, a dagger turning between her fingers. It is Xia Zhi.
event.y3d_returned.xia.2: "I said next time I would not hold back." She drops down without meeting your eyes.
event.y3d_returned.su.1: From the market-like crowd comes a familiar pipa, but the song is a new one. It is Su Dai.
event.y3d_returned.su.2: "I wrote a new song," she says, stilling the strings. "Fair warning: when you have heard it we fight."
event.y3d_returned.li.1: From the smithy below the platform comes a familiar hammering. Li Shan stands at the furnace beside a row of new blades.
event.y3d_returned.li.2: "The blades were made for others." He looks up. "If you would stop them, get past me first."
event.y3d_returned.xiao.1: A man comes up the road carrying only an old sabre and no armour. It is Xiao Hanchuan.
event.y3d_returned.xiao.2: "My debt is not yet paid." He stops. "But today I want to cross blades with you once."
event.y3d_returned.none.1: Nobody bars the steps. Those who walked with you either stand beside you or are long gone.
event.y3d_returned.none.2: That is fine. My mind is the clearer for it.
event.y3d_solstice.title: Solstice on the Platform
event.y3d_solstice.1: On the platform's Winter Solstice nobody sets off firecrackers. In the pavilions one great pot sends white steam up to the eaves.
event.y3d_solstice.2: To whom do you pass the first bowl of hot soup?
event.y3d_solstice.c.valley: The old friends: Shen, Lu and Bai
event.y3d_solstice.c.fighters: The comrades: Xie, Li and Xiao
event.y3d_solstice.c.street: The street companions: Su Dai and Xia Zhi
event.y3d_solstice.c.all: One pot, one bowl for everyone
event.y3d_gate_raid.title: The Night Raid
event.y3d_gate_raid.1: At midnight the torches below the steps go out row by row. Grey-clad men pour up the slopes from every side, blades low, pressing on the houses' awnings.
event.y3d_gate_raid.2: They do not want the platform. They want chaos.
event.y3d_masks.title: The Masks Take the Platform
event.y3d_masks.1: In the firelight three masked figures step onto the empty platform.
event.y3d_masks.2: "This gathering was once, two hundred years ago, a rewriting," the Xuan-Mask says among the pillars. "Today it is another's turn."
event.y3d_masks.3: "Enough talk," the Chi-Mask grins, drawing his sword. "The winner speaks."
event.y3d_masks.4: The Hui-Mask steps back behind a pillar and says softly, "I will not stop you."
event.y3d_masks.c.talk: Lower my weapon and let the Xuan-Mask finish
event.y3d_the_choice.title: The Choice
event.y3d_the_choice.1: Dawn. Below the platform the nine houses fix their eyes on you. The Accord fragments, the Head's token and the Masks' fallen masks all lie on the stone.
event.y3d_the_choice.2: Lei Zhenyue pushes the Head's token towards you. "Take it, refuse it or break it; it is yours to decide. This time no one decides for you."
event.y3d_the_choice.3: After three years of thinking, now it has come, I find it quiet.
event.y3d_the_choice.c.refuse: Refuse the seat and go home to the valley
event.y3d_the_choice.c.break: Destroy the manual and begin again
event.y3d_the_choice.c.gate: Take the Xuan-Mask's hand and the Gate
event.y3d_the_choice.c.walk: Put it all down and take the road alone
event.y3d_ending.title: The Dust Settles
event.y3d_ending.seat.1: The Head's token settles in your palm, lighter than imagined. The nine houses' banners rise together behind you.
event.y3d_ending.seat.2: Lei Zhenyue gives a soft laugh. "Good. At last someone shoulders it."
event.y3d_ending.refuse.1: You set the token back on the table, bow to the nine houses and go down the steps. The crowd behind you is silent a long while before the murmuring begins.
event.y3d_ending.refuse.2: The bamboo in the valley needs trimming.
event.y3d_ending.break.1: The fragments curl page by page in the brazier. Ash drifts past the pillars and the banners, and nobody speaks to stop it.
event.y3d_ending.break.2: The Hui-Mask has come to stand beside you. "Two centuries of rewriting end here."
event.y3d_ending.gate.1: The Xuan-Mask's hand is cold. The Gate's grey banner is quietly raised at the platform's south corner.
event.y3d_ending.gate.2: "From now on nobody in the realm need quarrel," he says, so calm as to be almost gentle.
event.y3d_ending.walk.1: You take nothing, shoulder your pack, and walk down the steps in the morning light.
event.y3d_ending.walk.2: The road is long and I have only begun.
event.ry12_platform_stones.title: The Nine Pillars
event.ry12_platform_stones.1: You walk once around the platform and know every house's name carved on the nine pillars.
event.ry12_steps_crowd.title: Those Who Recognise You
event.ry12_steps_crowd.1: The steps are packed, and some recognise you and whisper your name.
event.ry12_pavilion_envoys.title: Envoys Calling
event.ry12_pavilion_envoys.1: Envoys visit one another in the pavilions, cup after cup of tea and few words said.
event.ry12_courts_final.title: A Last Drill
event.ry12_courts_final.1: On the courts disciples of every sect drill together a last time, shouting as one.
event.ry12_valley_wait.title: The Lamp at the Gate
event.ry12_valley_wait.1: A-Fu hangs a lamp at the village gate, saying it is to light your road at the platform.
event.ry12_teahouse_bets.title: The Bets Stop
event.ry12_teahouse_bets.1: The teahouse bets have stopped. Nobody wagers any more; everyone wants to see the truth.
combat.scenario.y3_bracket.objective: Defeat the fighters each house sends onto the stage.
combat.scenario.y3_returned: An Old Companion Bars the Way
combat.scenario.y3_returned.objective: Beat the old companion and the helpers who stand with them.
battle.y3_returned: An Old Companion Bars the Way
combat.scenario.y3_platform_raid.objecti: Hold the steps and drive off the grey raiders.
combat.scenario.y3_masks.objective: Defeat the Xuan-Mask and the Chi-Mask.
ending.alliance_head.title: Path of the Alliance Head
ending.alliance_head.body: You took the Head's token and nine banners rose behind you. Three years on the road were not wasted: the fragments were gathered, the Accord held, and you drew a splintered world together with people who chose to walk with you.
ending.recluse.title: Recluse Grandmaster
ending.recluse.body: You set the token back and went home to Jade Valley. A small school grew among the bamboo; the far world quieted, and now and then someone crossed the hills to ask about the sword and went down again with a cup of tea.
ending.breaker.title: The Breaker
ending.breaker.body: The fragments turned to ash in the brazier and the Accord dispersed with them. Nobody knew what a new peace would look like, but you made everyone begin again, and gave everyone the chance to choose anew.
ending.undertow.title: The Undertow
ending.undertow.body: You took the Xuan-Mask's hand. The Gate's grey banner rose quietly, and the world went still, still as water above an undertow. Some were grateful, some fell silent, and some vanished overnight.
ending.long_road.title: The Long Road
ending.long_road.body: You shouldered your pack and went down from the platform. No perfect ending came together, but the road was still under your feet, and everyone who knew you had a road of their own.
epi.why_seat: You took the token, but too few stood with you; the Accord loosened in your hands until you set it down.
epi.why_refuse: You meant to go home, but the valley was no longer the valley you knew, and you took up your pack again.
epi.why_break: You burned the fragments, but no one near could take up what came after, and time was left to settle the rest.
epi.why_gate: No one stood surety for the Xuan-Mask's promise, and you turned away, leaving the grey banner on the stone.
epi.why_walk: You took nothing, and by daylight you were on the road.
epi.realm_6: A grandmaster, able to found a school, and still willing to crouch and teach a child to hold a stance.
epi.realm_5: You returned to simplicity, and no edge showed in a raised hand.
epi.realm_4: You reached the pure flame, every move landing as it should.
epi.realm_3: Everything integrated; fist and intent no longer parted.
epi.realm_2: Minor mastery was yours, and your name began to travel.
epi.realm_1: You entered the hall, and your forms learned to breathe.
epi.realm_0: You still remember the sweat on your palms the first time you took a stance.
epi.skill_high: Your {skill} was honed to perfection, and storytellers like to close on it.
epi.skill_mid: {skill} was the move you trusted most, and after three years it still taught you something.
epi.skill_low: You learned many moves in three years and carried none to its limit.
epi.shen_qinghe_redeemed: {name}: She became head of Listening-Rain Hall, and her master at last had his cure.
epi.shen_qinghe_alternate: {name}: She went to heal the border, still carrying the herbs you gave her.
epi.shen_qinghe_lost: {name}: The cure came too late, and she was rarely seen after.
epi.shen_qinghe_friend: She sends medicine, and a note that reads only: "Eat on time."
epi.shen_qinghe_sworn: You swore as siblings, and on rainy nights a lamp stays lit in the dispensary for you.
epi.shen_qinghe_romance: Under the eaves of Listening-Rain two cups of tea are always poured.
epi.shen_qinghe_rival: She still remembers that bowl of medicine, and what you left unsaid.
epi.lu_chenzhou_redeemed: {name}: He cleared the bureau's books, and cargo moved again along the ferry road.
epi.lu_chenzhou_alternate: {name}: He took to the caravan road alone, saying it suited him.
epi.lu_chenzhou_lost: {name}: The letter was sold in the end, the bureau burned, and he never returned to the ferry.
epi.lu_chenzhou_friend: Every trip he makes he brings you back some small thing.
epi.lu_chenzhou_sworn: You swore brotherhood at the ferry and poured the wine into the river.
epi.lu_chenzhou_romance: He said the river moon was good to share, and shared it for many years.
epi.lu_chenzhou_rival: You meet to spar each time, and the score is never settled.
epi.bai_yan_redeemed: {name}: He finished a true history, and copyists were fighting for it before the ink dried.
epi.bai_yan_alternate: {name}: He went back to the academy, where his lamp burned night after night.
epi.bai_yan_lost: {name}: He lost himself in the fragments, and the grey men took his notes.
epi.bai_yan_friend: His long letters are half scholarship and half asking how you are.
epi.bai_yan_sworn: On the day you swore, he left you a small seal carved with a single character: duty.
epi.bai_yan_romance: At the end of the history he wrote your name, rubbed it out and wrote "a friend" instead.
epi.bai_yan_rival: He is still unconvinced, and every letter argues over some old annotation.
epi.su_dai_redeemed: {name}: Her song became the key to the ninth fragment, and the teahouses sing it daily.
epi.su_dai_alternate: {name}: She went off with her pipa, and the next town will hear a new song.
epi.su_dai_lost: {name}: The song was stolen, and she never played it again.
epi.su_dai_friend: In every town she plays the tune you liked best.
epi.su_dai_sworn: You swore as siblings, and she calls that the longest harmony.
epi.su_dai_romance: Under the moon she plays her pipa string by string, for you alone.
epi.su_dai_rival: You answer each other across the tea table, and neither will stop first.
epi.li_shan_redeemed: {name}: He rekindled the forge, and the anvil rang across half the hill.
epi.li_shan_alternate: {name}: He kept a small shop, hammering only ploughshares and kitchen knives, and called it honest work.
epi.li_shan_lost: {name}: He forged blades for the Gate, and his fires burned grey ever after.
epi.li_shan_friend: He made you a small knife, not for fighting, he said, only for peeling apples.
epi.li_shan_sworn: You swore by the forge, sparks landing on your sleeves, and neither of you flinched.
epi.li_shan_romance: The iron bracelet he gave you has a tiny lotus cut inside.
epi.li_shan_rival: He says he can't beat you and asks for another round every time.
epi.xie_wujiu_redeemed: {name}: He returned to Cangwu as an instructor, and his disciples called him a good teacher.
epi.xie_wujiu_alternate: {name}: He left the sects with only an old sword, saying not everyone needs to understand his innocence.
epi.xie_wujiu_lost: {name}: He became another's fist, and when you met on the stage his eyes no longer knew you.
epi.xie_wujiu_friend: He drops by when free, says little, and lays his sword beside you.
epi.xie_wujiu_sworn: You swore at the cliff cave, and he said no one would wrong him again.
epi.xie_wujiu_romance: He is no talker, yet he has kept a single sentence of yours for three years.
epi.xie_wujiu_rival: Three years of draws, and neither will call it a draw.
epi.xia_zhi_redeemed: {name}: She turned on the Gate and drew its hidden lines into the open.
epi.xia_zhi_alternate: {name}: She vanished into the night alleys, leaving a small copper coin.
epi.xia_zhi_lost: {name}: She became the Gate's lieutenant, and grey men bowed their heads to her.
epi.xia_zhi_friend: She keeps climbing in over the wall, eating, and climbing out again.
epi.xia_zhi_sworn: You swore, and she told you the true name she never gave before.
epi.xia_zhi_romance: She leaves a spray of night jasmine at your window, unsigned.
epi.xia_zhi_rival: She still counts you a rival, and steals something of yours at every meeting.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_redeemed: {name}: He led the garrison at the pass, and smoke rose again over the villages below.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_alternate: {name}: He laid down his armour and became a wanderer, wanting to see spring beyond the pass.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_lost: {name}: He died holding the pass, the torn banner still in his hand.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_friend: His letters are short: weather, grain prices and a single word, safe.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_sworn: You swore in the snow, the blood on your palms freezing at once.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_romance: He wrote your name on the last page of the camp register, among his family.
epi.xiao_hanchuan_rival: Every year you spar at the pass, snow gathering on your shoulders, neither yielding.
epi.comp_unmet: Some you only brushed past; the world is large and fate sometimes allows a single nod.
epi.faction_pavilion: The Herb Pavilion keeps its sickbeds and furnaces behind you, and no one in the valley waits to die hungry.
epi.faction_couriers: The couriers' roads reach the valley gate, and news and cargo travel faster than before.
epi.faction_scribes: The scribes copied your tale dozens of times and sent it in every direction.
epi.faction_neutral: You bound yourself to no one, so everyone was willing to speak plainly before you.
epi.pledge_orthodox: The orthodox sects count you as their own, and their lecture halls open for you.
epi.pledge_trade: The trade houses and escort bureaus will stand surety for your word.
epi.pledge_free: Wanderers and free blades remember you; a jug of wine is a debt of honour.
epi.valley_kept: Jade Valley kept its name, and the lamp at the village gate burns on.
epi.valley_elder_fell: Elder Mo did not survive that winter, and the village still speaks of him.
epi.valley_away: The valley grew up while you were away; A-Fu says they did not wait for you, only left a lamp lit.
epi.wealth_rich: Your purse is heavy enough to jingle, though you scatter it coin by coin to those who need it.
epi.wealth_mid: You have savings enough to mend a house and keep a small school.
epi.wealth_low: Your purse is thin, but you owe nobody anything.
epi.deed_ninth_named: You wrote the name of the Ninth House into the register, and no later hand could rub it out.
epi.deed_star_read: You read the chart of the ninth star and left it for those who come after.
epi.deed_star_lost: The star chart collapsed underground, and no one has seen that page since.
epi.deed_trial: The trial on the cliff became a late-night tale among the Cangwu disciples.
epi.deed_xuan_pact: You have not forgotten your pact with the Xuan-Mask, and neither has he.
epi.deed_lei: Head Lei watched from the gate until your back was out of sight.
epi.image_alliance_head: On the platform the new banner unfurled and someone in the crowd laughed aloud.
epi.image_recluse: Dawn over the valley, dew on the bamboo tips, a child practising a stance in the yard.
epi.image_breaker: Wind carried the ash past the nine pillars, and the world suddenly felt wider.
epi.image_undertow: The grey banner hung still at the south corner, a shadow under water.
epi.image_long_road: The mountain road wound into the distance, you walked ahead, and someone behind called your name.
